'''Liwi fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that could be consumed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as other sentient beings. The fruit was served at [[Ithor Delicacies]], a food stand that operated on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" /> 
The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], offered liwi fruit and [[hoyy seed]]s as add-ons for its [[herd ship's bounty salad]]s&mdash;the diner's take on the traditional Ithorian [[covado salad]]&mdash;at the cost of an additional [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Liwi fruit was first mentioned in "[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]," a [[1991]] adventure supplement written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" />
